messages:
incbot: [ALERT] Elevated p95 latency observed for hosted inference in eu-west-1 at 2026-11-09 03:02 UTC. p95_token_time ~ 1.15s, error spike ~0.5%. Auto-runbook invoked. Paging @alice_oncall and @bob_sre.

alice_oncall: Acknowledged. Oncall here. Opening console and checking routing/queue metrics. Anyone who changed routing or model rollouts in last 3h? :mag_right:

bob_sre: I'm looking. GPU pool `eu-pool-03` showing sustained queue depth and slower batch flushes. Pulling dispatcher logs now: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/dispatcher-eu-03 --tail=500`. Also checking redis latency.

charlie_eng: We had a model-cache tweak around 00:15 UTC and bumped cache TTLs. Rolling change completed ~00:22. I'll inspect whether cache evictions increased.

dana_ops: Spinning up emergency burst nodes from Dedicated (burst job id burst-216999). ETA ~5m. I'll also nudge autoscaler to bias to eu-secondary if healthy.

alice_oncall: Thanks. Short-term mitigation: enable fallback to quantized smaller model variant. charlie, can you flip the feature flag for eu routes?

charlie_eng: On it. Running:
```
rdwctl features set enable_model_variant_fallback=true --scope=region:eu --env=prod
```
Feature toggled at 2169994408. Routing should start favoring `gen-quant-v2` for compatible requests.

incbot: Automated record: feature toggle applied by charlie_eng at 2169994408. Estimated p95 improvement: ~300ms.

bob_sre: Early telemetry shows queue length dropping, p95 down to ~780ms. KV cache hit rate dropped to 70% (baseline ~94%) which explains residual latency. Investigating if a cache key prefix change triggered mass invalidations.

dana_ops: Extra pods scheduled: 2x g4dn-equivalent starting. Command issued: `k8s scale --cluster eu-cluster --replicas +2 --label=pool=compute`. New pods transitioning Pending->Running.

emily_support: Preparing status page text and customer notifications. Will not publish until we confirm that mitigations are active and we have recommended text.

frank_product: Keep customer messaging short and actionable. Suggest including recommended mitigation: customers needing sub-200ms p95 consider Dedicated or region pinning.

emily_support: Draft for status.redwood.ai:

```
State: Degraded Performance
Detected: 2026-11-09 03:02 UTC
Scope: Hosted inference in eu-west-1
Impact: Increased API latency (p95) and a small transient increase in error rate for some requests.
Mitigation: Engineers enabled model fallback to a smaller quantized variant and provisioned additional capacity. Monitoring ongoing.
Next update: in 15 minutes or upon significant change.
```

alice_oncall: Good. Add: "No indications of data loss" and link to support contact. Also tag affected customers by API key region.

emily_support: Added. I'll stage the status update and prepare outbound emails to EU-keyed customers if p95 remains >750ms for another 10 minutes. Subject suggestion: "Redwood Inference: temporary EU performance degradation (Nov 9)".

pagerduty_bot: Reminder: please prepare a concise handoff note to the next oncall in 30 minutes.

alice_oncall: Handoff summary template I'm leaving: root cause suspected: cache invalidation cascade + batcher backpressure; mitigations: model fallback, +2 GPUs, cache TTL patch canary; current p95: 770ms; no data loss; postmortem required after resolution. Link logs: https://logs.prod/redwood/incident/2169994321.

charlie_eng: Deploying small TTL fix to eu canary: `deploy canary cache-ttl-fix --region=eu --percent=5`. If stable after 10m, we will ramp.

bob_sre: Suppressing duplicate alerts for the same symptom for 1h to reduce noise: `incbot silence symptom=eu-p95-spike duration=1h`.

alice_oncall: Handing over to @bob_sre at 2169995121. Please continue monitoring and escalate to failover if p95 > 800ms after 20m. I'll be reachable via DM. :handshake:

bob_sre: Taking over. I'll monitor KV hit rate and p95 and coordinate with ops for further capacity if needed. Opening a postmortem doc and adding initial notes.

emily_support: Internal CS/Sales brief queued in #support-private with bullet points: what happened, current status, recommended replies. If prolonged, we will send customer email.

incbot: INCIDENT UPDATE at 2169994800: p95 improved to ~740ms. Actions: model fallback, +2 GPUs, cache TTL canary. Continued monitoring.

frank_product: Please keep CS brief minimal: 1) what affected, 2) how we mitigated, 3) recommended switching to dedicated for strict SLOs.

alice_oncall: Marking for postmortem after recovery. Action: `postmortem: cache invalidation chain and autoscaler granularity` assigned to charlie_eng and bob_sre.

bob_sre: Acknowledged and will file the postmortem with timelines and graphs. :memo:

emily_support: Final customer email template (ready if needed):

```
Subject: Redwood Inference  Temporary performance degradation in EU (Nov 9)
Body: Hello,

We observed increased latency for hosted inference in our EU region between 03:02 and XX:XX UTC on Nov 9. Engineers applied mitigations (model fallback and additional capacity) and most customers saw restoration by 03:40 UTC. No customer data was impacted. If you experienced continued issues, please reply or open a support ticket.

Regards,
Redwood Support
```

alice_oncall: Thanks everyone. I'll update the public status page with a timeline once p95 remains <400ms for 30m or when product signs off. Closing my oncall shift and handing to bob_sre now.

end.
